Definition: from G1223 and G906; (figuratively) to traduce:--accuse.
BiblicalUsage: This word means to accuse, to speak against a man through a crowd until the charge sticks. It stands only once, where the unjust steward is accused to his master of wasting his goods, and the accusation is what brings his whole life to a reckoning.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that an accusation is a serious thing, whether it is true or false; the steward's waste was real, and the master had a right to ask for an account, which is why the parable ends by asking me to look at my own stewardship.
